title: Immutable base-object continuity on additive successor heads
failure_signature: A sealed closeout test reads current HEAD lifecycle cardinality and rejects a legitimate additive successor commit.
trigger_preconditions: A special continuation validates an already sealed base phase without rewriting its historical tests.
candidate_workaround: Read the sealed truth from the exact base Git object, verify base-to-current ancestry, and run only successor-compatible scoped modules.
recurrence_guard: Do not execute historical HEAD-count assertions as if an additive successor were still the sealed phase head.
rollback: Retain the failed historical assertion and keep the base test byte-stable.
scope_boundary: Base continuity only; immutable receipt reading does not replay or expand the sealed canonical suite.
